displayName: NoETL EHDB: tier-store appends are failing (log-corruption guard)

conditions.displayName: NoETL EHDB: tier-store appends are failing (log-corruption guard)

documentation.content: Appends to the EHDB tier store are failing. This store is what the event-log tier serves FROM while it is `primary`. Append failures preceded the 2026-08-12 log corruption (noetl/ai-meta#261): concurrent writers tore the transaction log, 302 of 348 appends failed, and one torn record made EVERY read fail. Fixed in worker#276 (v5.118.1); steady state is 0, so any increase is actionable. Check the writer's disk and /data/eventbus/ehdb-tier/eventlog.jsonl. Ref noetl/ai-meta#261.
